title: “Jeremiah had almost no visible success.”
paragraphs:
“Jeremiah had almost no visible success.”
“Solomon had unmatched visible success.”

Fruit can impress people.
Faithfulness impresses heaven.

One fills stadiums.
One fills God’s heart.

One shines like gold.
One weeps in the rain.
📖 “It is required that those who have been given a trust must prove faithful.” — 1 Corinthians 4:2
How do we measure faithfulness today?

By numbers?
By noise?
By influence?
Or by obedience when no one is watching?
